text.body: <1> samyagdarśana jñāna cāritrāṇi mokṣamārgaḥ|| tattvārthaśraddhānaṃ samyagdarśanam|| tannisargādadhigamādvā|| jīvajīvāsrava bandhasaṃvaranirjarāmokṣāstattvam|| nāmasthāpanā dravya bhāvatastannyāsaḥ|| pramāṇanayairadhigamaḥ|| nirdeśasvāmitvasādhanādhikaraṇa sthitividhānataḥ|| satsaṃkhyākṣetra sparśanakālāntara bhāvālpabahuttvaiśca|| matiśrutāvadhimanaḥ paryaya kevalāni jñānam|| tatpramāṇe|| ādye parokṣam|| pratyakṣamanyat|| matiḥsmṛtiḥ saṃjñācintābhinibodha ityānarthāntaram|| tadindrayānindriyanimittam|| avagrahehāvāya dhāraṇāḥ|| bahubahuvidhakṣiprāniḥ sṛtānukta dhruvāṇāṃ setarāṇām|| arthasya|| vyañjanasyāvagrahaḥ|| na cakṣuranindriyābhyām|| śrutaṃ matipūrvaṃ hyanekadvādaśabhedam|| bhavapratyayo'vadhirdevanārakāṇām|| kṣayopaśamanimittaḥ ṣaḍvikalpaḥ śeṣāṇām|| ṛjuvipulamatī manaḥ paryayaḥ|| viśuddhyapratipātābhyāṃ tadviśeṣaḥ|| viśuddhikṣetrasvāmiviṣayo'vadhimanaḥ paryayayoḥ|| matiśrutayornibandho dravyeṣvasravapāryāyeṣu|| rūpiṣvavadheḥ|| tadanantabhāge manaḥ paryasya|| sarvadravyaparyāyeṣu kevalasya|| ekādīni bhājyāniyugapadekasminnācaturbhyaḥ|| matiśrutāvadhayo viparyayaśca|| sadasatoraviśeṣādyadṛcchopalabdherunmattavat|| naigamasaṃgrahavyavahārarju sūtraśabda samabhirūḍhaivaṃbhūtā nayāḥ|| iti prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|| <2> aupaśamikakṣāyikau bhāvau miśraśca jīlasya svatattvamaudayika pāriṇāmiko ca|| dvinavāṣṭādaśaikaviṃśātitribhedā yathākramam|| samyaktva cāritre|| jñānadarśana dānalābhabhogopa bhogavīryāṇi ca|| jñānājñāna darśana labdhyaścatustri tripañcabhedāḥ samyaktva cāritra saṃyamāsaṃyamāśca|| gatikaṣāyaliṅga mithyādarśanā jñānāsaṃyatā siddha leśyāścatuścatustryekaikaikaikaṣaḍbhedāḥ|| jīvabhavyābhavyatvāni ca|| upayogo lakṣaṇam|| sa dvividho'ṣṭacaturbheda|| saṃsāriṇo muktāśca|| samanaskāmanaskāḥ|| saṃsāriṇastrasasthāvarāḥ|| pṛthivyaptejovāyuvanaspatayaḥ sthāvarāḥ|| dvīndriyādayastrasāḥ|| paṃcedriyāṇi|| dvividhāni|| nirvṛtyupakaraṇe dravyendriyam|| labdhyupayogau bhāvendriyam|| sparśanarasana ghrāṇacakṣuḥśrotrāṇi|| sparśanarasangandhavarṇaśabdāstadarthāḥ|| śrutamanindriyasya|| vanaspatyantānāmekam|| kṛmipipīlikā bhramara manuṣyādīnāmekaika vṛddhāni|| saṃjñinaḥ samanaskāḥ|| vigrahagatau karmayogaḥ|| anuśreṇi gatiḥ|| avigrahā jīvasya|| vigrahavatī ca saṃsāriṇaḥ prāk caturbhyaḥ|| eka samayāvigrahā|| ekaṃ dvau trīnvānāhārakaḥ|| saṃmūcchaṃnagarbhauparādā janma|| sacittaśītasaṃvṛtāḥsetarā miśrāścaikaśastadyonayaḥ|| jarāyujāṇḍajapotānāṃ garbhaḥ|| devanārakāṇāmupapādaḥ|| śeṣāṇāṃ saṃmabarcchanam|| audārikavaikriyikā hārakadaijasakārmaṇāni śarīrāṇi|| paraṃ paraṃ sūkṣmam|| pradeśato'saṃkhyeyaguṇaṃprāk taijasāt|| anantaguṇe pare|| apratīghāte|| anādisaṃbandhe ca|| sarvasya|| tadādīni bhājyāniyugapadekasminnā caturbhyaḥ|| nirūpabhogamantyam|| garbhasamabarcchanajamādyam|| aupapādikaṃ vaigriyikam|| labdhipratyayaṃ ca|| taijasamapi|| śubhaṃ viśuddhamavyāghāti cāhārakaṃ pramattasaṃyatasyaiva|| vānakasaṃmūrcchino napuṃsakāni|| na devāḥ|| śeṣastravedāḥ|| aupapādika caramottamadehā'saṃkhyeya varṣāyuṣonavartyāyuṣaḥ|| iti dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| <3> ratnaśarkarābālukāpaṃka dhūmatamomahātamaḥ prabhā bhūmayo ghanāmbuvātākāśa pratiṣṭhāḥ saptādho'dhaḥ|| tāsu triṃśatpaṃcaviṃśati paṃcadaśadaśatripaṃconaikanarakaśatasahasrāṇi paṃca caiva yathākramam|| nārakā nityāśubhataraleśyāpariṇāma dehavedanāvikriyāḥ|| parasparodīritaduḥkhāḥ|| saṃkliṣṭāsurodīritaduḥkhāśca prāk caturthyāḥ|| teṣvekatri sapta daśasaptadaśatdavā viṃśati trayastriṃśatsāgaropamāsattvānāṃ parā sthitaḥ|| jambūdvīpa lavaṇodādayaḥ śubhanāmāno dvīpasamudrā|| dvirdvirviṣkambhāḥ pūrvapūrvaparikṣepiṇo valayākṛtayaḥ|| tanmadhye merunābhirvṛtto yojanaśatasahasraviṣakambho jambūdvīpaḥ|| bharatahemavataharivideha ramyaka hairaṇeyavatairāvatavarṣāḥ kṣetrāṇi|| tadvibhājinaḥ pūrvāparāyatā himavanmahāhimavanniṣadhanīlarukmi śikhariṇo varṇadharaparvatāḥ|| hemārjunatapanīya vaiḍūryarajata remamayāḥ|| maṇivicikṣaparśvā upari mūle ca tulyavistārāḥ|| padmamahāpadmatigiñchakesari mahāpuṇḍarīkapuṇjarīkāhṛdāsteṣāmupari|| prathamo yojanasahasrāyāmastadardhaviṣakambho hradaḥ|| daśayojanāvagāhaḥ|| tanmadhye yojanaṃ puṣkaram|| taddviguṇadviguṇāhradaḥ puṣkarāṇi ca|| tannivāsinyo devyaḥ śrī hrīdhṛtikīrtibuddhilakṣmyaḥ palyopamasthitayaḥ sasāmānika pariṣatkāḥ|| gaṃgāsindhu rohidrohitāsyāhariddharikāntai sītāsītodānārīnarakāntā suvarṇa rūpyakūlā raktāraktodāḥ saritastanmadhyagāḥ|| dvayordvayoḥ pūrvāḥ pūrvagāḥ|| śeṣāstvaparagāḥ|| caturdaśanadīsahasraparivṛtā gaṃgāsindhvādayo nadyaḥ|| bharataḥ ṣaḍviṃśatipaṃcayojanaśatavistāraḥ ṣaṭcaikonaviṃśatibhāgāyojanasya|| taddviguṇadviguṇavistārā varṣadharavarṣā videhāntāḥ|| uttara dakṣiṇatulyāḥ|| tathottaraḥ|| videheṣu saṃkhyeyakālāḥ|| bharatasya viṣkambho jambūdvīpasya navatiśatabhāgaḥ|| dvirdhātakīkhaṇḍe|| puṣkārardhe ca|| prāṅmānuṣottarānmanuṣyāḥ|| āryā mlecchāśca|| bharatairāvatavidehāḥ karmabhūmayo'nyatra devakurūttarakurubhyaḥ|| nṛsthitīparāvare tripalyopamāntarmuhūrta|| tiryagyonijānāṃ ca|| iti tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| <4> devāścaturṇikāyāḥ|| āditastriṣu pītānatleśyāḥ|| daśāṣṭapañcadvādaśavikalpāḥ kalpopapannaparyantāḥ|| indrasāmānika trāyastriśapāriṣadātmarakṣa lokapālīnāka prakīrṇa kābhiyogya kilbiṣi kāścaikaśaḥ|| trāyastriṃśalokapālavarjyā vyantarajyotiṣkāḥ|| pūrvayordvīndrā|| kāyapravīcārāḥ|| śeṣāḥ sparśarūpaśabdamanaḥ pravacārāḥ|| pare'pravacīrāḥ|| bhavanavāsino'suranāvidyutsuparṇāgnivātastanitoda dhidvīpadikkumārāḥ|| vyantarāḥ kinnarakiṃpuruṣa mahoraga gandharvayakṣarākṣasabhūtapiśācāḥ|| jyotiṣkāḥ sūryācandramasau grahanakṣatraprakīrṇakatārakāśca|| merupradikṣiṇā nityagatayo nṛloke|| tatkṛtaḥ kālavibhāgaḥ|| bahiravasthitāḥ|| vaimānikāḥ|| kalpopapannāḥ kalpātātāśca|| uparyupari|| saudharmaiśānasānatkumāra māhendra brahmabrahmottara lāntavakāpiṣṭha śukramahāśukraśatārasahasrāreṣvānataprāṇayorāraṇācyutayornavasugraiveyakeṣu vijaya vaijayanta yayantāparājiteṣu sarvārthasiddhau ca|| sthiti prabhāvasukhadyutaleśyāviśuddhīndriyāvadhiviṣayato'dhikāḥ|| gatiśarīraparigrahābhimānato hīnāḥ|| pītapadmaśuklaleśyā dvitriśeṣeṣu|| prāggraiveyakebhyaḥ kalpāḥ|| brahmalokālayā laukāntikāḥ|| sārasvatāditya va hrayaruṇagardatoyuṣitāvyāvādhāriṣṭāśca|| vijayādiṣu dvicaramāḥ|| aupapādika manuṣyebhyaḥ śeṣāstiryagyonayaḥ|| sthitisuranāgasuparṇadvīpaśeṣāṇāṃ sāgaropamatripalyopamārddha hīnamitāḥ|| saudharmeśālayoḥ sāgaropame'dhike|| sānatkumāra māhendrayo sapta|| trisaptanavaikādaśatrayodaśa pañcadaśabhiradhikāni tu|| āraṇācyutatādūrdhvamekaikenanavasu graiveyakeṣu vijayādiṣu sarvārthasiddhau ca|| aparāpalyopamamadhikam|| parataḥ parataḥ pūrvā pūrvā'nantarā|| nārakāṇāṃ ca dvitīyādiṣu|| daśavarṣajñasahasrāṇi prathamāyām|| bhavaneṣu ca|| vyantarāṇāṃ ca|| parāpalyopamamadhikam|| jyotiṣkaṇāṃ ca|| tadaṣṭabhāgo'parā|| laukāntikānāmaṣṭau sāgaropamāṇi sarveṣām|| iti caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| <5> ajīvakāyā dharmādharmākāśapudgalāḥ|| dravyāṇi|| jīvāśca|| nityāvasthitānyarūpāṇi|| rūpiṇaḥ pudgalāḥ|| ākāśādekadravyāṇi|| niṣkriyāṇi ca|| asaṃkhyoyāḥ pradeśā dharmādharmekajīvānām|| ākāśasyānantāḥ|| saṃkhyeyāsaṃkhyeyāśca pudgalānām|| nāṇoḥ|| lokākāśe'vagāhaḥ|| dharmādharmayoḥ kṛsne|| ekapradeśādiṣu bhājyaḥ pudgalānām|| asaṃkhyeyabhāgādiṣu jīvānām|| pradeśasaṃhāra visarpābhyā pradīpavat|| gatisthtyupagrahau dharmādharmayorupakāraḥ|| ākāśasyāvagāhaḥ|| śarīravāṅmanaḥ prāṇāpānāḥ pudgalanānām|| sukhaduḥkhajīvitamaraṇopagrahāśca|| parasparopagraho jīvānām|| vartanāpariṇāmakriyāḥ paratvāparatve ca kālasya|| sparśarasagandhavarṇavantaḥ pudgalāḥ|| śabdasaukṣmyasthaulya saṃsthāna bhedataśchāyātapodyotavantaśca|| aṇavaḥ skandhāśca|| bhedasaṃghātebhya utpadyante|| bhedāduṇuḥ|| bhedasaṃghātābhyāṃ cākṣuṣaḥ|| saddravyalakṣaṇam|| utpādavyayadhrauvyuktaṃ sat|| tadabhāvāvyayaṃ nityam|| arpitānarpitasiddheḥ|| snigdharukṣatvād bandhaḥ|| na jaghanyaguṇānām|| guṇasāmye sadṛśānām|| dvayādhikādiguṇānāṃ tu|| bandhe'dhikau pāriṇāmikau ca|| guṇaparyayavat dravyam|| kālaśca|| so'nantasamayaḥ|| dravyaśrayā nirguṇā guṇāḥ|| tadbhāvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ|| iti pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| <6> kāyavāṅmanaḥ karma yogaḥ|| sa āsravaḥ|| śubhaḥ puṇyasyāśubhaḥ pāpasya|| sakaṣāyākaṣāyayoḥ sāṃparāyikeryāpathayoḥ|| indriyakaṣāyāvrata kriyāḥ pañcacatuḥ pañcapañcapabiṃśatisaṃkhyāḥ pūrvasya bhedāḥ|| tīvramandajñātājñāta bhāvādhikaraṇa varyiviśeṣebhyastadviśeṣaḥ|| adhikaraṇaṃ jīvājīvāḥ|| ādyaṃ saṃrambha samārambhārambha yoga kṛtakāritānumata kaṣāyaviśeṣestristristriścatuścaikaśaḥ|| nirvartanānikṣepasaṃyoga nisargā dvijaturdvivatribhedāḥ param|| tatpradoṣa nihravamātsaryāntarāyāsādanopaghātā jñānadarśanāvaraṇayoḥ|| duḥkha śokatāpā krandana vadhaparidevanānyitmaparobhayasthānyasadveghasya|| bhūtavratyanukampādānasarāga saṃyamādiyogaḥ kṣāntiḥ śaucamiti sadvedyasya|| kevaliśrutasaṃgha dharma devāvarṇavādo darśanamohasya|| kaṣāyodayāttīvrapariṇāmaścāritramohasya|| bahvārambhaparigrahatvaṃ nārakasayāyuṣaḥ|| māyātiryagyonasya|| alapārambhaparigrahatvaṃ mānuṣasya|| svabhāvamārdavaṃ caṃ|| niḥśīlavratatvaṃ ca sarveṣām|| sarāgasaṃyama saṃyamāsaṃyamā kāma nirjarābālatapāṃsi daivasya|| samyaktvaṃ ca|| yogavakratā visaṃvādanaṃcāśubhasya nāmnaḥ|| tadviparītaṃ śubhasya|| darśanaviśuddhirninaya sampannatā śīlavavrateṣvanatīcāro'bhīkṣṇa jñānopayogasaṃvegau śakti tastyāgatapasī sādhu samādhirvaiyāvṛttyakaraṇa marhadācārya bahuśruta pravacana bhakti rāvaśya kā parihāṇirmārgaṃ prabhavanāpravacana vatsalatva mititīrthakaratvasya|| parātmanindā praśaṃse sadasadguṇocchādanodbhāvane ca nīcairgautrasya|| tadviparyayo nīcairvṛttyanutsakau cottarasya|| vighnakaraṇamantarāyasya|| iti ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|| <7> <8> hiṃsāva-tasteyābrahmaparigrahebhyau viratirvratama|| deśasarvato'ṇumahatī|| tatsthairyāthā bhāvanāḥ pāñca pañca|| vāṅgamanoguptīryādāna nikṣepaṇa samityālokitapāna bhojanāni paṃca|| krodhalobha bhīrutva hāsya pratyākhyānānyuvī cibhāṣaṇaṃ ca paṃca|| śūnyāgāra vimocitā vāsaparodhā karaṇa bhaikṣaśuddhisamadharmāvisaṃvādāḥ paṃca|| strīrāga kathā śravaṇatanmanoharāṃga nirīkṣaṇapūrva ratānusam raṇa vṛṣyeṣṭa sarasvaśarīra saṃskāra tyāgāḥ paṃca|| manojñāmanotrajñandriya viṣaya rāgadveṣa varjanāni paṃca|| hiṃsādiṣvahāmutrā pāyāvadyadarśanam|| duḥkhameva vā|| maitrīpramoda kāruṇyamādhyasthyāni ca sattvaguṇādhika kliśyamānāvinayeṣu|| jagatkāyasva bhāvau vā saṃvega vairāgyartham|| pramattayogātprāṇavyaparopaṇaṃ hiṃsā|| asadabhidhānamanṛtam|| adattādānaṃ steyam|| maithunamabrahma|| mūrcchā parigrahaḥ|| niḥśalyo vratī|| agāryanagāraśca|| aṇuvrato'gārī|| digdeśānarthadaṇḍa viratisāmāyika proṣa dhopavāsopabhogaparibhogaparimāṇātithisaṃvibhāgavratasaṃpannaśca|| māraṇāntikīṃ sallekhanā joṣitā|| śaṃkākāṅakṣāvicikatsānyadṛṣṭi praśaṃsā saṃstavāḥ samyagdṛṣṭeratīcārāḥ|| vrataśīleṣu pañca pañca yathākramam|| bandhavadhacchedātibhāropaṇānnapānanirodhāḥ|| mithyopadeśa rahobhyākhyānakūṭalekhakriyā nyāsāpahāra sākāramantra bhedāḥ|| stena prayogatadāhvatādāna viruddharājyātikramahīnādhika manonmāna pratirupaka vyavahārāḥ|| paravivāhaka raṇetvarikā parigṛhītā gamanānāṅgakrīḍā kāmatīvrābhiniveśāḥ|| kṣetravāstuhiraṇya suvarṇadhana dhānya dāsīdāsa kupya pramāṇatikramāḥ|| ūrdhvādhastirya gvyatikramaḥkṣetra vṛddhismṛtyantarādhānāni|| ānayana preṣya prayoga śavdarupānupāta pudgalakṣepāḥ|| kandarpakautkucya maukharyāsamīkṣyādhikaraṇopabhoga paribhogānarthakyāni|| yogaduṣpraṇidhānānāda rasmṛtyanupasthānāni|| apratyavekṣitā pramārjitotsargādānasaṃstaropakramaṇā nādara smṛtyanupasthānāni|| sacitta sambandhasaṃmiśrābhiṣavaduḥ pakvāhārāḥ|| sacittanikṣepā pidhānaparavya padeśamātsaryakālātikramāḥ|| jīvitamaraṇāsaṃsamitrānurāga sukhānubandha nidānāni|| anugrahārtha syasyātisargo dānam|| vidhidravyadātṛpātraviśeṣāttadviśeṣaḥ|| mithyādarśanāviratipramādakaṣāyayogā bandhahetavaḥ|| sakaṣāyatvājjīvaḥ karmaṇoyogyān pudganānādatte sa bandhaḥ|| prakṛtisthityanubhavapradeśāstadvidhayaḥ|| ādyo jñāna darśanāvaraṇavedanīya mohanīyāyurnāmagotrāntarāyāḥ|| pañcanavadvyaṣṭāviṃśati caturdvicatvāriṃśaddvipañca bhedā yathākramam|| matiśrutāvadhimanaḥ paryayakevalānām|| cakṣuracakṣura vadhikevalānāṃ nidrā nidrā nidrāpacalā pracalāstyanagṛddhayaśca|| sadasadvedye|| darśanacāritramohanīyā kaṣāya kaṣāya bedanīyākhyā stridvinavaṣoḍaśabhedāḥ samyaktva mithyātvatadubhayānya kaṣāyakaṣāyau hāsya ratyaratiśoka bhaya jugupsāstrīpunnapuṃsaka bedā anantānubandhya pratyākhyāna pratyākhyāna saṃjvalana vikalpāścaikaśaḥ krodhamāna māyā lobhāḥ|| nārakatairyagyonamānudaivāni|| gatijātiśarīrāṅgopāṅganirmāṇa bandhasaṃghāta saṃsthānasaṃhanana sparśa rasa gandha varṇanupūrvyāgurulaghūpaghātaparaghātātapodyotocchavāsa nihāyogatayaḥ pratyekaśarotrasa subhagasusvaraśubhasūkṣmaparyāpti sthirādeya yaśaḥ kīrtisetarāṇitīrthakaratvaṃ ca|| uccainīṃcaiśca|| dānalābhogopabhogavīryāṇām|| āditastisṛṇāmanrāyasya ca triṃśatsāgaropamakoṭī koṭayaḥ parā sthitaḥ|| saptatiramohanīyasya|| viṃśatirnāmagotrayoḥ|| trayastriśatsāgaropamāṇyāyuṣaḥ|| aparā dvādaśa muhūrttā vedanīyasya|| nāmagautrayoraṣṭau|| śeṣāṇāmantarmuhartāḥ|| vipāko'nubhavaḥ|| sa yathānāma|| tataśca nirjarā|| nāmapratyayāḥ sarvato yoga viśeṣātsūkṣmaikakṣetrāvagāha sthitāḥ sarvātma pradeśoṣvanantānta pradeśāḥ|| sadvedyaśubhāyurnāmagotrāṇi puṇyam|| ato'nyatpāpam|| ityaṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| <9> āsravanirodhaḥ saṃvaraḥ|| sa gupti samiti dharmānuprekṣāparīṣahajayacāritraiḥ|| tapasā nirjarā ca|| samyagyoga nigraho guptiḥ|| īryābhāṣaiṣaṇā dāna nikṣepotsargā samitayaḥ|| uttamakṣamāmārdavārjavasatya śaucasaṃyama tapastyāgā kiñcanya brahmacaryāṇi dharmaḥ|| anityāśaraṇa saṃsāraikatvānyatvāśucyāsravasaṃvara nirjarā lokabodhi durlabha dharmasvākhyātattvānucintanamanuprekṣāḥ|| mārgācyavananirjarārtha pariṣoḍhavyāḥ parīṣahāḥ|| kṣutpipāsāśītoṣṇadaṃśamaśakanāgnyāratistrī caryāniṣadyāśayyā krodha vadhayācanālābha roga tṛṇasparśa mala satkāra puraskāra prajñānāṃ darśanāni|| sūkṣmasāṃparāyachadmasthavītarāgayoścaturdaśa| ekādaśa
